title.en: DeepSeek Harness installs no longer stall
title.zh: DeepSeek Harness 安装不再卡住

description.en: DeepSeek Harness installations now avoid an npm dependency resolver issue that could leave setup stuck at Resolving dependencies, especially on Windows.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 安装现已避开 npm 依赖解析问题，修复了安装过程停在“正在解析依赖项”的情况，尤其改善了 Windows 上的安装体验。
